warnings: This is a Zn fertilization study, not a CO2 study - the primary outcome is grain Zn concentration
Paper has two separate experiments: field experiment with 20 cultivars and observational study with 4 cultivars from 55 locations
Table 4 data is from field collections, not controlled experiments - may not be suitable for meta-analysis
Multiple cultivars tested - each cultivar represents an independent observation
Paper focuses on phytic acid but also reports grain Zn concentrations which is the target outcome
WARNING: SCANNED PDF - Text may have OCR errors
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: LSDZn, cv values provided at bottom of tables (e.g., Table 1: 'LSDZn, cv 0.14, 0.44' for P and '0.8, 2.6' for Zn)
recon.control_definition: No Zn fertilization (-Zn = 0, no Zn added)
recon.treatment_definition: Zn fertilization (+Zn = 23 kg Zn ha⁻¹ applied as ZnSO4·7H2O)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: None - treatment and control are clearly defined and labeled
recon.sample_size_source: randomized complete block design in strip plots with four replications
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract grain Zn concentration data from Table 1 only. Each of the 20 cultivars represents an independent observation with n=4 replications. Control is -Zn treatment, treatment is +Zn treatment. Use LSD values provided for variance. Do not extract Table 4 data as it's observational, not experimental. Zn concentrations are reported in mg kg⁻¹ DW.

table_descriptions.Table 1: Effect of Zn fertilization on concentrations of P and Zn in 20 wheat cultivars - contains grain Zn concentration data
table_descriptions.Table 2: Effect of Zn fertilization on concentrations of phytic acid and phytic acid to Zn molar ratios - no grain Zn concentration
table_descriptions.Table 3: Phytase activity in 20 wheat cultivars - enzyme activity data only
table_descriptions.Table 4: Observational data from 55 locations in Turkey - not controlled experiment

recon.extraction_method_reason: Scanned/image tables - use vision to supplement text
challenge_hints: Verify all numbers carefully - OCR may confuse 0/O, 1/l/I
If numbers look wrong, flag for manual review
Check Methods section for 'mean ± SE' or 'mean ± SD' statement
Check table footnotes for variance definitions
